messages.content: "請你幫我計算四個人的身體質量指數（BMI）嗎？第一個人的體重為85公斤，身高為175公分，第二個人的體重為60公斤，身高為160公分，第三個人的體重為75公斤，身高為180公分，第四個人的體重為90公斤，身高為185公分。所有的測量單位都是公制。"

function.name: calculate_bmi
function.description: Calculate the Body Mass Index (BMI) of a person. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

weight.description: Weight of the person in kilograms.

height.description: Height of the person in centimeters.

unit.description: Optional parameter to choose between 'imperial' and 'metric' systems. Default is 'metric'.

message.reasoning:
The user wants BMI calculations for four people. They gave weight in kg and height in cm. They want all in metric. We can compute BMI = weight / (height_m)^2. Height in cm convert to meters: divide by 100. So:

1st: weight 85 kg, height 175 cm -> 1.75 m. BMI = 85 / (1.75^2) = 85 / 3.0625 = 27.78 approx.

2nd: 60 kg, 160 cm -> 1.60 m. BMI = 60 / (1.6^2) = 60 / 2.56 = 23.44.

3rd: 75 kg, 180 cm -> 1.80 m. BMI = 75 / (1.8^2) = 75 / 3.24 = 23.15.

4th: 90 kg, 185 cm -> 1.85 m. BMI = 90 / (1.85^2) = 90 / 3.4225 = 26.32.

We should round to two decimal places. Provide results. Also we can use the function calculate_bmi. The function expects weight, height, unit optional. We can call it four times.
